a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead. The reserve's 4 cells can save only one unit right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than follow our original agreement, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and we'll likely both fall short, so it's your call how to respond. If the episode continues afterward, I'll operate every round to help refill the reserve for you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
